title: Shopping at a Clothing Store
summary: Browse a cozy clothing store: rack, tag, try something on, self-checkout.
script:
Imagine you’re opening the door and walking into a cozy clothing store.

Listen. You can hear the soft sounds of the store around you.

You slowly walk past the racks of clothes.

A rack is a structure where clothes hang in the store.

You stop and look at a few jackets.

You gently run your hand over the fabric. There is a beautiful leather jacket that catches your eye.

To catch your eye — in the past, caught your eye — means to attract your attention because you notice or like something.

You take the jacket off the rack and look at the tag.

A tag is a small label attached to clothing that usually shows information like the size or price.

It’s your size.

You decide to try it on.

To try something on means to put on clothes to see how they look or fit.

You walk toward the fitting room.

You step inside, close the door, and slowly put on the jacket.

Listen. You can hear the quiet sounds of the store outside.

You look at yourself in the mirror, and you love it.

Take a slow breath in…

and breathe out…

You change back into your clothes and leave the fitting room.

You walk to the self-checkout and place the jacket down.

The self-checkout is the place where you scan and pay for your items yourself.

Listen. You’re scanning the jacket.

Now, imagine gently tapping your card on the machine to pay.

Then, you put your jacket in a bag.

Your shopping is done.

Breathe in…

and breathe out…

Enjoy the rest of your day.

Bye.
